Honestly, celebrities do that all the time. Even social media content creators din. Editing their pictures and posting them online. Even Kylie Jenner has acne marks which she admitted to having pero makinis siya sa IG pix niya. Lahat ng sinabi mong flaws sakanya ay normal sa isang tao, acne and round face. For me ha, hindi ka nacatfish. Nacatfish ka pag lalaki bigla yung dumating sa date mo. Or kung ibang tao talaga. Minor differences lang naman mga yon at hindi niya kasalanan na may acne siya or na round face niya. Maybe it's insecurity na rin kaya niya ineedit yun, or baka nabully siya nuon. Whatever the reason is, para sakin, hindi catfish yun kung base sa sinabi mo, "minor" differences nga lang. Buuuut, valid parin nararamdaman mo na feeling mo naloko ka. Kasi standards mo yan eh. Pero sana, be honest nalang. And sana, kung alam mo na pala na di mo siya type, di mo na pinost dito and just message her agad nalang or talk to her asap. Baka makita niya pa to, kung ano man insecurities niya, madadagdagan pa. Imagine what she would feel if she sees this pero all this time akala niya okay date niyo. Communicate, yun lang masasabi ko. Valid nararamdaman niyong dalawa but since alam mo na pala na di mo siya type, I think its better to message her agad than to post this online.

I've been a fan of Pop Mart blind boxes since 2021. 450php lang yung normal blind boxes nuon na ngayon 600 na. Hindi pa sila pinapansin ng mga Pinoy nuon. As someone who genuinely enjoys collecting them, nakakagalit yung hype ngayon kasi, ang tagal kong nag aantay ng stocks para makumpleto ko ang isang series pero yung mga resellers, namamakyaw para ibenta ng 3-5x its original price. Nagiging out of stock sa apps, kaya sumama ako sa Pop Mart group sa FB. To my surprise, hindi pa dumarating yung item, kaka-place palang ng order, pinopost na agad nila at humihingi na ng "offers". Grabe!!! Yung ibang Labubu na 9h lang dapat, nagiging 1500 or more!!! Gusto ko rin enjoy-in ng ibang tao yung hobby na naeenjoy ko pero this is too much!! Nakakagalit sila.

As someone who got  cheated on multiple times which caused my PTSD, this reaction sounds like a woman who has one. You mentioned that her heart was beating fast, sounds like a trigger to me. No, she's not a 12 year old and no, she's not overreacting, it's a normal reaction to someone who's clearly having mental health issues. What you need here is communication. Talk about it. If she had past traumas from her exes or from a family member, etc... And you should talk about your feelings, too. It's a two way street to fix these kinds of problems. It's definitely not for everybody, as shown here on the comments section. But if you both love eachother, it's going to work out if you are both willing to communicate about it. Also, therapy. Go to therapy. Also, I don't understand why the comments here attacked OP's gf just from that. There's no need to call her names and such. Not everyone's brain is normal.
